name: Jace Reawakened
oracle_text:
You can't cast Jace Reawakened during your first, second, or third turns of the game.
+1: Draw a card, then discard a card.
+1: You may exile a nonland card with mana value 3 or less from your hand. If you do, it becomes plotted.
−6: Until end of turn, whenever you cast a spell, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
blocked_sentences: +1: You may exile a nonland card with mana value 3 or less from your hand. If you do, it becomes plotted.

needs.what: an op (or an `exile` option) that exiles a chosen card from a zone other than the stack -- here a nonland card with mana value 3 or less from your hand -- and makes it plotted: the standing 702.171a permission to cast it as a sorcery on a later turn without paying its mana cost (playable_duration 'later_turns' + playable_free + playable_sorcery_only), emitting the 'plotted' event
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `grant_plot` takes only `sid`/`target` and marks a resolving spell on the stack (Lilah), turning it into the plotted permission in stack._place_after_resolution; it cannot reach a card in hand. `exile` with `playable: "later_turns"` gives the later-turn start but no way to set `playable_free` or `playable_sorcery_only`, so the card would be castable at its full price and at instant speed -- a different card. `cast_from_hand`/`play_exiled` cast now, not later.
